# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

198 tools: 190 API tools + 7 helper tools (guide and workflows) + `tiendanube_oauth_exchange_code`. In read-only mode (`configure --read-only` or `TIENDANUBE_READ_ONLY=true`) 83 tools are registered: the 78 API read tools and the 5 read-safe helpers.

Naming: `tiendanube_<domain>_<action>`. Every tool lists its HTTP route and required OAuth scope in its description, and carries MCP annotations (`readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`).

| Domain | Tools |
| --- | ---: |
| Store & media | 2 |
| Catalog, inventory & price lists | 43 |
| Orders, fulfillment & carts | 31 |
| Customers | 5 |
| Coupons & promotions | 11 |
| Locations, shipping & business rules | 23 |
| Payments, disputes, invoices & app billing | 25 |
| Pages, blog, email templates & scripts | 15 |
| Metafields, custom fields, custom objects & webhooks | 35 |
| Guide & workflows | 7 |

| `tiendanube_webhooks_delete` | `DELETE /webhooks/{id}` | scope of the event's entity | **destructive** |

## Guide & workflows

Start with `tiendanube_start_here`.

| Tool | What it does | Read-only mode |
| --- | --- | :---: |
| `tiendanube_start_here` | CALL THIS FIRST. Map of tasks to tools, golden rules and recipes for this store. | yes |
| `tiendanube_find_tool` | Describe what you want to do in plain language (Spanish or English) and get the matching tools and recipes. | yes |
| `tiendanube_get_recipe` | Step-by-step recipe (exact tool names and arguments) for a common job such as combos, price changes or stock. | yes |
| `tiendanube_doctor` | Diagnose credentials, connection and missing permissions, with the exact next steps to fix them. | yes |
| `tiendanube_api_request` | Call any Tiendanube API route that has no dedicated tool (last resort before asking the user). | yes |
| `tiendanube_create_combo` | Create a combo/pack product from products already in the store, with price, stock and images (generated files supported). | no |
| `tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file` | Upload an image file from this computer (e.g. one you generated) to a product. | no |
